name: Blood and Fog
description: Find the Secret Stairway tile and escape from the dungeon before the Zombie Dragon consumes you.

objectives.description: All Heroes must escape via the Secret Stairway tile.

specialRules.description: Defeated Undead Monsters cannot be spent as Experience to cancel Encounter Cards, but can be used to level up Heroes.
When the Rotting Nook is revealed, place the Zombie Dragon instead of drawing a Monster; it activates each Villain Phase.
A Hero ending their Hero Phase on the stairway of the Secret Stairway tile escapes and is removed from play except for Villain Phase activations.

introText: The Heroes are trapped and must find another exit through blood-soaked mist-filled crypts.
victoryText: All Heroes escape through the Secret Stairway! The mist swirls behind you as you leave the horrors of Ravenloft behind.
defeatText: The Zombie Dragon or the dungeon's terrors overwhelm you. The mist claims another victims.
